reason: The money isn't the issue, $19 is nothing to me. But my admin already pulls the receipts together when I ask, and half of what goes out is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a bot reading the chat would only see part of the picture.
objection: It can only read what people actually send. The leaks I worry about are cash payments and inflated parts prices, and a tidy spreadsheet of the receipts that do show up won't catch those.
would_change_my_mind: If I uploaded our old Telegram history on the free trial and it turned up real duplicates or totals that don't add up, money I didn't know I'd lost, I would pay without thinking about it.
